subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should maintainers require a fresh redacted Google Chat Space @mention payload before changing the mention-gate behavior that remains after the shipped classifier fix?
rationale: Source review proves a drop path when mention facts do not match, but the latest report says botUser was already configured, so live payload shape is needed before choosing a fallback or relaxing strict app-target matching.

options.title: Require Live Payload Then Patch
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted Space @mention capture, then patch the plugin against the observed annotations and add actionable diagnostics.

options.title: Patch From Source Only
options.body: Proceed with a source-only diagnostic or fallback change, accepting that it might not match the current Google Chat payload shape in the reporter's workspace.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Work
options.body: Move the remaining concern under the broader Google Chat Space/threading discussion if maintainers want one product umbrella for Space behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Live Payload Then Patch
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted Space @mention capture, then patch the plugin against the observed annotations and add actionable diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the access policy, mention gate, and Google Chat thread/routing surfaces involved in the remaining decision.
